pending_commit.commit_message: pack_firmware: Move image/keyset vars into setvars.sh At present for unified builds we set the IMAGE_... and KEYSET_DIR variables at the top of updater4.sh. We plan to allow sharing of images between models. To make this more flexible, move setting of these variables into the setvars.sh script. This script is created by the firmware packer so with this change we can (in the future) set the variables as needed. When sharing images, for example, we will adjust the variant for one model's image to point to another's. pack_firmware: Support the 'shared' property Add basic support for a model sharing another model's firmware. So far this just grabs the same files and includes them in the update twice. Future work will allow sharing the files without expanding the size of the firmware update. To support looking up the property, add a function to follow a phandle link. This is not supported in the libfdt Python bindings yet, so we need to add our own version. We also need a byteswap function since this is not currently exported. cros_build_lib: Move chroot image management into python Having make_chroot.sh handle all the image management seemed like a good idea originally because it keeps all the setup together and avoided having python call out to the shell a bunch of times. Unfortunately, it led to a lot of complication and corner cases related to tracking mounts inside and outside of the mount namespace that cros_sdk creates. This CL converts all the loopback/LVM setup to python (still via calls to external binaries, though). The next step will be to simplify the chroot setup by doing all the image setup and mounting directly in cros_sdk outside the child mount namespace. BUG=chromium:730144 TEST=New unit tests; trybots. CHROMIUM: arm64: dts: rockchip: change trigger mode for elan on scarlet In http://crosreview.com/522266 we changed the trigger mode for the elan trackpads and touchscreens on rk3399-gru-bob. However, we didn't change it for gru. That meant that when we created rk3399-gru-scarlet we accidentally copied the wrong example. Now that we're fixing it for gru (see http://crosreview.com/613682) let's also fix it for scarlet to avoid any similar problems for scarlet and also to avoid leaving any bad examples around.
